verification: Actual source-only CLI before/after on immutable retained1730, maker18, sprites50 and checker38 memberships, preserving duplicates, errors and panics. YAML/model diagnostics remain separate. Compact fresh controls use parent existing reference runner only. Required gates once stable. No baselines, comparator, acceptance contract or historical review edits; new independent checker required.
invariant: A command candidate consumes input only when recognized at the current position. An unrecognized prefix contributes literal characters while preserving later recognized commands, including a sprite inside unmatched angle markup. Literal characters preserve Unicode boundaries and escaping precedes command recognition.
causal_divergence: Rust eagerly advances through the first greater-than before deciding whether a tag is recognized. An unknown outer prefix therefore absorbs an inner sprite command. Java searches its first-character command candidates against the entire remaining string, then consumes one literal UTF-16 character when none matches, reaching the later inner command. Rust can preserve the same string and command boundaries by stepping Unicode scalar values, without splitting UTF-8.
planned_change: Make internal tag dispatch report recognition, scan a tentative cloned character iterator, and commit it only for a recognized command. Unknown/no-close angle prefixes consume just the already-read less-than as literal. Keep recognized non-sprite dispatch and escape ordering, segment barriers, public APIs and consumers unchanged. No general HTML rewrite; URL recursion and legacy to_svg_tspans remain dependencies.
